_comment: core-architecture-wave3 FR-10. Module cycles between core domains that already exist: `a<->b` means a/ references crate::b AND b/ references crate::a. A pair here warns; a NEW pair fails the build. Rust does not reject intra-crate cycles and clippy has no lint for them, so this list is the only thing stopping the graph getting worse. Shrink it, never grow it.
